title.narrative: Förderung des sozialen Engagements von Jugendlichen zur Stärkung der Zivilgesellschaft in Indien
Promoting the social engagement of young people to strengthen civil society in India

description.narrative: In India, young people are often susceptible to manipulation through patriarchal and sexist discourses, consumerist endeavours and nationalist rhetoric that influence them. This has serious consequences in a society where nationalism is on the rise and violence against non-dominant castes, minorities and women continues. The aim of the project is to build social and entrepreneurial leadership skills among young people and to encourage them to bring about social change in themselves and in society.
